title: Import the 30 Lichess aliases the diacritic rule had parked
description: The remainder of docs/manifests/lichess-exact-aliases.manifest.json. Those 155 rows passed five filters; these passed all of them except one — BANNED_ASCII_NAME_FORMS, which rejected the ASCII spelling of an eponym in the aliases column. That rule now binds canonical_name only (see the 2026-08-14 amendment in docs/diacritic-normalization-map.md), because an alias records how a name is searched for rather than how it should be written, and 'Ruy Lopez' is what the world's databases and search boxes type. Same provenance as the 155: exact position match against lichess-org/chess-openings, the name identifies exactly one row in the cross-reference, the row had no alias at all, and nothing here is already another row's canonical name or alias. Evidence: docs/evidence/provenance/lichess-alias-import.md.
